During retarded cooling the y'-phase particles coagulate
During retarded cooling the y'-phase particles coagulate, but this process is not complete and the groups of particles contacting each other do not form a single common particle
Such selective migration of the boundaries is observed primarily in zones occupied by y'-phase and absent in areas where it is not.
The particles block the grain boundaries and reduce their capacity for migration.
